budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town Accountant reported the FY22 tax rate was certified lower than FY21.

budget_items.topic: MIIA Risk Management grant for Microsoft 365
budget_items.what_was_recorded: A MIIA Risk Management grant was reported to purchase Microsoft 365 licenses.

budget_items.quote: the town has been denied the community compact it grant, and the town will have to pay $52,000 to purchase infrastructure.

budget_items.quote: that there is not much the town can do to receive an increase in those funds.
